title: GOOGLE_OUT
description: Output contract of Google Engine (08_GOOGLE_ENGINE.md). Not in the original 6-file schemas/ list from 02_ARCHITECTURE.md -- added here for the same validation rigor as the other engines once real code was written.

pin_map_url.description: Roadmap view with the marker drawn, used as the opening frame of the storyboard so the video starts on a recognisable pinned-map shot.

input_kind.description: Whether the caller supplied a map link / coordinate pair (used as-is, free and exact) or a text address (geocoded, billable).

nearby.description: Points of interest around the property. Optional -- a Places failure must not invalidate the location result.

highlight_lines.description: Ready-to-use factual selling lines, e.g. "ใกล้โรงพยาบาล 1.2 กม." -- safe for highlight_features (no price, no contact, no hype).

x-error-codes.ERR_GOOG_01: Ambiguous address -- retry with coarser input, else fall back to the province's default coordinates
x-error-codes.ERR_GOOG_02: API rate limit (403/429) -- substitute a generic placeholder image, do not block the workflow

x-hard-rules: Never hallucinate lat/lng -- must come from a real Geocoding API response.
Reject coordinates outside plausible bounds for the input country/region.
Sign public static map URLs (requires a separate URL-signing secret, not yet configured -- see code comment).
Cache-first: never re-geocode the same property_id -- Phase 1 DB/Redis not built yet, so cache_hit is always false for now.
